meta.title: Update all
meta.description: Adds a one-click "lazy update" sidebar entry: updates every installed plugin that has a newer version in one go, puts plugins that are still inside the release maturity hold into their own waiting category outside the run, and lets a "skip the cooling-off period" switch install them right away with pnpm's release-age check lifted for that one call; installs over plugins the desktop app refuses to hot-remove and asks for a restart to apply them, reloads the page after client-only updates so a new session cannot hit two module versions, offers a one-click DSH restart when the Host half changed, and hands off to the desktop app's built-in updater when an app update is available.
